target: Shot D prepared-result hero endpoint keyframe
narrative_job: Deliver the payoff that the delegated backstage work returns as one authored, prepared result; the composition must feel calmer, more decisive and materially different from the manual-work opening.
before_state: The prior Agent backstage sequence has completed its hidden operations and converged on one deliverable.
crossing_state: The result enters the human world as a single authored object/surface and the camera settles instead of continuing transit.
after_state: The user is no longer switching tools; one finished presentation/report dominates the frame while the surrounding desk and body language are visibly calm.
must_have: one unmistakable finished result as the sole hero subject
composition and shot scale materially different from Shot A
decisive camera settle or reveal implied by the endpoint
physically believable screen, paper, glass and desk materials
result readable as authored and complete even if all text is blurred or removed
calm visual rhythm after the prior transition
must_not_have: celebratory particles as the main payoff
meaning that depends on explanatory copy
engine_route: Static endpoint keyframe first using the cheapest image route that can reach the photographic material floor. Exact typography/data, if later needed, is deterministic compositing. Premium video is forbidden until the endpoint still passes and Shot B/C staging proves the causal chain.
stop_conditions: prompt turns the payoff into a dashboard or floating UI card
more than one result competes for attention
the result only reads as complete because of legible labels
ending resembles the opening composition too closely
review challenge is not independently executed
hero still would not survive thumbnail-size inspection
exact_prompt: Vertical cinematic hero frame, photographed realism. The same real desk environment is now quiet and visually resolved after unseen work has completed. A single finished presentation/report is the dominant subject on the laptop as one full-bleed authored page rather than an app interface: a strong central market visual with a restrained chart and imagery integrated as one composition, no grid of widgets and no interface chrome. The user's hands are no longer switching tools; one hand rests away from the controls as the body subtly leans back. Physical desk objects remain but are subordinate and orderly. Use a materially different composition from the opening: wider breathing room, decisive perspective, clean depth separation, believable glass and paper reflections, motivated practical light completing the earlier warm/cool arc, serious commercial-film cinematography. The image must communicate 'prepared result has arrived' from posture, calmness and visual convergence even if all written text is unreadable. No futuristic mascot, no holographic menu, no floating cards, no blue-neon control wall, no celebratory particles.

art_director.notes: Independent Art Director must verify that the result has material weight, controlled lighting and a decisive hero composition rather than looking like a polished laptop mockup.

creative_director.notes: Independent Creative Director must verify that the ending functions as a narrative payoff and meaningful contrast to Shot A rather than collapsing back into product-demo language.

red_team.notes: Strongest risk is that a laptop showing a finished page still collapses back into product-demo language. Independent Red Team must challenge whether posture, scale and material staging carry the payoff without UI dependence.
